DEMO 1 — LIVE IMAGE GENERATION (3 minutes)
PRE-SETUP: Bing Image Creator must be open in browser BEFORE this slide. Pre-login with a Microsoft account. Tab ready.
STEP 1: Ask a student in the front row — "Shout 3 completely random words. Anything. Don't think." Common answers: "flying elephant Eiffel Tower" / "dinosaur cricket IPL" / "Doraemon sabzi mandi"
STEP 2: Type the phrase slowly in front of the class (so they watch you type). Click Generate.
STEP 3: SILENCE while it generates. This silence is GOLD. Don't fill it. Let the anticipation build.
STEP 4: Image appears. Pause for 5 full seconds. Let them react. Don't say anything immediately.
STEP 5: Then ask the hook question: "Did the computer draw this? Or did it think?" Don't answer it. Just plant the seed and move on.
NOTE: If Bing is slow, have a backup prompt pre-generated in another tab to show immediately.
